title: Graduate classical mechanics
purpose: Work with Hamiltonian structure, constraints and canonical transformations at graduate problem depth.
primary_reading: Perimeter PSI Online course collection — Select the Theoretical Mechanics, Statistical Physics or Cosmology module matching this course. Use the module notes and exercises by topic.

blocks.deliverable: Demonstrate a conservation statement with brackets.
Construct and verify a nontrivial canonical map.
Week 7 midterm; solve an integrable example.
Locate equilibria and assess a small perturbation.
Count physical degrees of freedom carefully.
Defend the assumptions and complete a graduate problem examination.

project: Analyze a constrained mechanical model and identify its conserved quantities and physical degrees of freedom.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
